picks.title: Chaos releases V-Ray 7.4 for Blender
picks.excerpt: Chaos shipped V-Ray 7.4 for Blender, adding a Quick Sun Caustics system, UDIM support, Cycles-to-V-Ray lighting conversion, and tighter integration with Veras, its architectural AI rendering software.
picks.rationale: Major renderer update for the huge Blender user base — Cycles-to-V-Ray conversion and AI (Veras) integration directly change how 3D/arch artists render tomorrow.

picks.title: Foundry releases new AI-powered SmartRoto add-on for Nuke
picks.excerpt: Foundry released an AI-powered SmartRoto add-on for Nuke that automatically propagates and deforms roto splines across a shot, claiming to speed up rotoscoping 'up to 4x' versus manual work.
picks.rationale: AI that automates one of VFX's most tedious tasks — up-to-4x faster rotoscoping in Nuke is an immediately actionable workflow change; distinct accent since it shares the render category.

picks.title: Meshy wants AI to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
picks.excerpt: Meshy's new conversational 3D Agent keeps context across a session so creators can set art direction and generate stylistically consistent, production-ready 3D assets, positioning AI as a creative partner rather than a one-shot prompt.
picks.rationale: A conversational 3D Agent that holds art-direction context across a session reframes prompt-based 3D generation as a collaborative workflow — novel and directly relevant to designers' asset pipelines; adds a distinct outlet and category.
